recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-11176; do not republish FHIR-11347 because it already has a combined-branch audit commit, and treat FHIR-10725 as a separate binding issue.
issue_request: FHIR-11176 is a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request from the DSTU2 ballot asking to differentiate CareTeam.type and CareTeam.name. The accepted resolution required CareTeam.name to be defined as a human label for distinguishing like teams and to include a usage note that the team meaning/purpose is conveyed by CareTeam.type, or CareTeam.category if the related rename was approved.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in source history by c124072d7bc14dd9eea48ac1aaf530bcd31171a6, whose message explicitly includes #11176 and whose patch changed the then-authoritative CareTeam spreadsheet source from a generic name definition to the approved distinguishing-label definition, added the usage note, and recorded committee note GF#11176. Later source refactors carried that content into the current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: FHIR-11347, approved in the same block, renamed CareTeam.type to CareTeam.category and is already represented on the combined branch by audit commit f1e353f19862042a87c0d3f83079cf19914c7beb. The current CareTeam resource is active in source/fhir.ini, current source defines CareTeam.category, and the CareTeam.name comment correctly points meaning/purpose to CareTeam.category. FHIR-10725 is related background for CareTeam status/category terminology binding but does not affect the name/category distinction. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community rationale.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active source already implements the final Jira resolution for CareTeam.name, including the related category rename, so further edits would be redundant polish rather than a necessary correction.

related_jiras.note: Same CareTeam block vote renamed CareTeam.type to CareTeam.category, which determines the correct property name in FHIR-11176's usage note; already audited on the combined branch.
